1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] Weighted minimum bound: let p_1, ..., p_m be positive reals with sum_i p_i = 1 and let n_1, ..., n_m be real numbers; then min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
  1.1 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] The index set {1, ..., m} is nonempty, i.e. m >= 1.
  1.2 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] The quantity mu := min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i is well-defined, and there exists an index k with n_k = mu.
  1.3 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, n_i >= mu.
  1.4 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] For every i in {1, ..., m}, p_i * n_i >= p_i * mu.
  1.5 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] sum_i p_i * n_i >= sum_i p_i * mu.
  1.6 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] sum_i p_i * mu = mu * sum_i p_i.
  1.7 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] mu * sum_i p_i = mu * 1 = mu.
  1.8 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] sum_i p_i * mu = mu.
  1.9 [[32mvalidated[0m/[32mclean[0m] min over i in {1, ..., m} of n_i <= sum_i p_i * n_i.
